Asian Greens With Sesame Dressing
By: Helen Pitlick
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




1 6 oz bag asian greens, washed
1/4 cup orange juice
1 tablespoon tamari sauce
1 tablespoon rice vinegar
1 tablespoon honey
2 teaspoons sesame oil
2 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds

Preparation

1 Place washed greens in large bowl or on individual plates. 2 Combine all liquid ingredients; whisk to blend. Pour dressing over salad just before serving; sprinkle with sesame seeds.

About


If you cannot find "asian greens," use spinach or lettuce.
